# Stallwart

> Stallwart is the company behind Extrovert AI, a full AI-powered CRM that
> runs the entire lead lifecycle on autopilot: capture, scoring, follow-up,
> and re-engagement.

## Company
- Name: Stallwart
- Tagline: Built Beyond.
- Product: Extrovert AI — the full AI-powered CRM on autopilot
- Domain: https://stallwart.in
- ICP: B2B sales teams, SMB and Enterprise, primarily US and UAE

## What Extrovert AI does
1. Lead Capture — automatically ingests inbound signals from all channels
2. Automatic Scoring — ranks leads by real buying signals
3. Auto Follow-Up — sends timed, context-aware follow-ups without manual effort
4. Automated Outreach & Re-Engagement — revives cold leads automatically
